requirements.invariant: Summary-only input cannot satisfy semantic packet custody.
Lifecycle terminal envelopes cannot become semantic authority packets.
Pointers, digests, receipts, manifests and compiler output cannot replace the complete artifact.
Only fresh runtime-owned evidence can produce a mechanical admission handle.
Web PASS cannot bind consumable acceptance before fresh packet readback.
Missing, inaccessible or incorrectly versioned custody stores fail closed.
An interrupted insertion transaction leaves no partial artifact.
A producer crash before readback cannot create acceptance.
Fresh-process retrieval survives loss of producer process and session fixtures.
Acceptance recovery is idempotent after a projection interruption.
Projection write uncertainty is reconciled by fresh state, not blind repetition.
Any semantic content mutation invalidates the complete artifact identity.
Packet identifiers are recomputed from the whole canonical artifact.
Custody is bound to the exact namespace database identity.
Repository, parent, child, lane and owner bindings are independently exact.
Producer run, lock, stage, role and schema remain immutable.
Authority revision must be current or explicitly reusable.
Candidate PR, head, tree and base are exact and successor applicability is explicit.
Producer and consumer identities remain distinct while sharing an explicit dependency.
Web acceptance references the exact packet, readback and decision.
Closed canonical packet validation rejects malformed values and alternate encodings.
Unknown versions and downgrade attempts are rejected.
Sensitive values in every content-bearing field reject persistence.
Oversize and unsafe values fail before content-changing insertion.
Supporting evidence references survive exact roundtrip but references alone do not.
Same-process objects and envelopes cannot substitute for fresh-process proof.
Delivery requires the envelope and exact full packet.
Delivery mutations are detected by consumer recomputation.
G3 can admit from bounded CURRENT and exact accepted predecessor without chat history.
Every direct consequential entry point requires the common receipt-owned prerequisite.
Wrappers, aliases and atomic paths cannot substitute for the common prerequisite.
Durable lifecycle summaries cannot reconstruct a semantic admission.
CURRENT readback is mandatory for admission.
CURRENT contains only bounded dependency references and no packet body.
Repeated persistence, acceptance and projection preserve one immutable artifact.
CURRENT may shrink only after obsolete dependencies cease to be required; custody remains.
Chronology enumeration cannot substitute for bounded CURRENT recovery.
Identical persistence is idempotent by complete identity.
Conflicting content under one producer key cannot replace the original.
Concurrent identical writers resolve to one artifact.
Conflicting concurrent writes have one winner and no dual acceptance.
Superseded packets and acceptances cannot be replayed as current.
Ambiguous insertion, readback, projection and dispatch outcomes reconcile without duplicate side effects.
No-predecessor admission requires explicit trusted classification.
Declared consumers and finality applicability remain bound to authority.
Required packets remain retrievable through process restart and pending finality.
Append-only custody survives update, delete, replace and capacity-pressure cleanup attempts.
Explicitly authorised complete historical packets may be backfilled without relabelling the producer.
Summaries, fragments, memory and inferred historical values cannot be backfill sources.
Unprovable required historical dependencies return typed rerun-required HOLD.
Runtime and workers cannot create Web acceptance or finality authority.
Transport readback proves delivery only and cannot mint semantic authority.
Existing receipt and privacy negative contracts remain rejecting.
Cross-repository packets fail at every consequential admission surface.
Packet custody remains offline and does not fall back to a network store.
Lifecycle receipts, compiler artifacts and chronology are not canonical custody.
V2 to V4 migration is explicit, quiescent and preserves historical bytes while V3 remains dormant.
Schema fingerprints, append-only guards and relational bindings are independently verified on reopen.
Fresh-reader runtime, stream, challenge and environment boundaries fail closed.
Packet delivery has its own bounded capacity and does not alter the RUN_STARTED ceiling.
Receipt and Loop imports expose complete APIs without circularity bypass.
A crash after dispatch intent produces an ambiguous hold and no automatic relaunch.
Historical absent packet fields preserve exact projection bytes while explicit fields roundtrip.
Combined source integration preserves Run-059 compiler oracles and all nine #448 shipping tests.
Plain objects shaped like routes, reports or assurance cannot substitute for an opaque admission.
Capacity blocks new writes but required existing packets remain readable.
